title: PECO Free First Sunday Family Day: Thriving Traditions at the Barnes
description: Free gallery access plus art activities, scavenger hunts, storytime at 10:30 AM, and Native Nations Dance Theater performances at 1 PM and 2:30 PM for Indigenous Peoples' Day. Registration is required and capacity is limited.

title: Van Gogh's Sunflowers at the Philadelphia Museum of Art
priceLabel: Free with museum admission (check source for price)
description: Two of Van Gogh's Sunflowers paintings, one from London's National Gallery and one from the PMA collection, hang side by side in Colket Gallery 251 through October 11. The show is included with museum admission.

title: Autumn's Colors and Illuminated Fountain Performances at Longwood Gardens
description: Autumn's Colors runs October 2 to November 15 with harvest displays, a garden railway, daytime fountain shows at 10:15, 12:15, 2:15 and 4:15, and illuminated fountain performances in the evening. Gardens are open until 9 PM Friday through Sunday.

title: Reading Liederkranz Oktoberfest
description: A longtime Oktoberfest with Dave Kline & Bavarski, tuba and waltz competitions, schuhplattlers and a beer-tapping parade on Saturday. Sunday is Family Day with the Garrett Tatano Band, a magician and a bounce house.

title: The Philadelphia Orchestra: Yannick Conducts Mahler's Symphony No. 5
description: Yannick Nézet-Séguin conducts Mahler's Fifth, with its famous Adagietto, alongside Webern's Im Sommerwind and Julia Wolfe's new Liberty Bell; about two hours with intermission.

title: Philadelphia Eagles vs. Los Angeles Rams
address: 1 Lincoln Financial Field Way, Philadelphia, PA 19148
description: Week 4 home game against the Rams on FOX; Eagles are 3-0 against LA over the past two seasons. Open Streets West Walnut also shows the game live.

title: Evil Genius 15th Anniversary Block Party with Wheatus
address: Front St and Palmer Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19122
description: Evil Genius Beer celebrates 15 years with a street festival on Front Street: eight bands from noon, including Tell All Your Friends and Lunar Pools, and a Wheatus headline set from 8 to 10 PM. Vendors and neighborhood food and drink on site.

title: Fells Point Fun Festival (60th annual)
address: Thames St from Caroline St to Wolfe St, Baltimore, MD 21231
description: Baltimore's 60th annual harborfront street festival: six blocks of live music, 225+ food and craft vendors, a Maryland beer, wine and spirits park, a family fun park and a Sunday pet parade.

title: Fleurs de Villes: The Gilded Age at Lynnewood Hall
description: A floral exhibition inside the Gilded Age mansion Lynnewood Hall, open to the public for the first time in decades. Last entry is 5 PM, and the run ends Sunday, October 4.

title: Pumpkinland at Linvilla Orchards
time: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM Sat; 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM Sun
priceLabel: Free entry; mazes from $7, hayrides from $9
description: Free-to-walk fall festival with giant scarecrows, hayrides, straw bale and corn mazes, train and pony rides, and apple blasters. Individual activities are ticketed separately.

title: Experience the Unexpected: Wand and Potion Making at Morris Arboretum
description: Visitors make magical wands and potions from natural materials, free with general admission, alongside the Pumpkin Cottage and the 19th annual Scarecrow Walk running October 1 to November 1.

title: Bordentown Cranberry Festival
venue: Farnsworth Avenue (Burlington St to Park St)
description: The 36th annual juried arts and crafts festival fills downtown Farnsworth Avenue both days with more than 100 artists and crafters, plus live music and food.

title: Scarecrows in the Village at Peddler's Village
address: Route 202 and Street Rd, Lahaska, PA 18931
description: Now in its 47th year, over 100 scarecrows line the brick pathways of Peddler's Village daily through October 26, alongside seasonal shops and restaurants.

title: Clover Market in Bryn Mawr
venue: Downtown Bryn Mawr (N Bryn Mawr Ave and Lancaster Ave)
address: 7 N Bryn Mawr Ave, Bryn Mawr, PA 19010
description: About 90 curated vintage and handmade vendors, food trucks, live music by Matt Kresge from noon to 3 PM, and free kids' crafts, steps from the Bryn Mawr SEPTA station.

title: Horsegirl & Cowdaddy at the Wilma Theater

times.2026-10-03: 7:00 PM (Open Caption and Black Affinity Night)

description: A 1 hour 45 minute play in its final weekend, running through October 4. The Wilma lists content warnings for simulated sex acts, partial nudity, kink, strobing lights, loud sounds and haze.

title: Ancient Egypt in Watercolors at the Penn Museum
description: Century-old watercolors of Egyptian tombs never before shown in the United States are on view while the Ancient Egypt and Nubia galleries are renovated (reopening December 12, 2026). Open Tuesday through Sunday.

title: Noguchi to Asawa: Designing Postwar America at the Barnes
description: The Barnes presents Noguchi to Asawa through January 10, 2027, alongside Sky Hopinka: Red Metal Dust and Just Us (through October 12). Open Thursday through Monday, 11 AM to 5 PM; Sunday October 4 is Free First Sunday with registration.

title: Spooky Mini Golf at Franklin Square
description: Philly Mini Golf puts on its Halloween costume, with a course of famous Philadelphia landmarks decorated for the season. Open daily through October.

title: Reading Terminal Market
description: The historic public market is open daily 8 AM to 6 PM, so both weekend days work for lunch and browsing. Its fall events, the Scrapple & Apple Festival on October 17 and others, come later in the month.

title: Chestnut Hill Night of Lights
description: Six projected video exhibitions light up storefront windows along Germantown Avenue, telling 250 years of Northwest Philadelphia history, with live music and storytellers at the sites. Hosted by the Chestnut Hill Conservancy.

title: Brew N' History Tour at Christ Church Burial Ground
description: A guided walk past the graves of Benjamin Franklin and Declaration signers, with five stops pairing local craft beer samples with stories of colonial tavern culture.

title: Pumpkin Patch Flyer train ride
venue: Woodstown Central Railroad, South Woodstown Station
description: An 18-mile vintage train ride through Salem County to Fenwick Grove, with about 45 minutes in the pumpkin patch and one pumpkin to take home. The full trip runs about 1 hour 45 minutes.

title: Philadelphia Zoo and Boo at the Zoo
description: The zoo is open daily 9:30 AM to 5 PM (last entry 4 PM), and its Halloween event Boo at the Zoo is included with general admission, with trick-or-treating for costumed kids.

title: Open Streets: West Walnut
venue: Walnut St (Broad to 19th) and 18th St (Chestnut to Locust)
address: Walnut St between Broad St and 19th St, Philadelphia, PA 19103
description: Nearly eight car-free blocks of Walnut Street with live music, bubble artists, a kids' zone, mini golf and live Eagles game broadcasts at the Fulton Fun Zone.

title: Headhouse Farmers Market
description: The Food Trust's year-round Sunday market under the historic Head House shambles, with regional farmers, bakers and prepared-food vendors.

title: Giargiari Bel Canto Competition
address: 300 S Broad St (Perelman Theater, Kimmel Center), Philadelphia, PA 19102
description: The Academy of Vocal Arts' resident opera singers compete in demanding bel canto arias before judges and an audience that votes for the Audience Choice Award.

title: The Fillmore Philadelphia: Switchfoot with Anberlin (Forever Now Tour)
description: Alt-rock band Switchfoot headlines with special guest Anberlin at the Fishtown venue as part of the Forever Now Tour.

title: The Fillmore Philadelphia: Rise Against with Alkaline Trio (Ricochet 2026)
description: Punk veterans Rise Against play the Fishtown venue on the Ricochet 2026 tour, with Alkaline Trio and Teen Mortgage in support.

title: Hershey Bears Home Opener vs. Charlotte Checkers (Opening Night)
description: The 13-time Calder Cup champion Bears open their AHL home season with a Saturday opening night magnet-schedule giveaway and a Sunday Dark Nights Takeover with Hersheypark Halloween characters.

title: Jim Thorpe Fall Foliage Festival
address: Broadway & Race St, Jim Thorpe, PA 18229
description: Craft and food vendors, free live music at four locations, and scenic Lehigh Gorge train excursions in the Switzerland of America; the first of three October foliage weekends.

title: Geoffrey Asmus at Helium Comedy Club
description: Stand-up Geoffrey Asmus, who has opened for Dave Attell and Mark Normand, headlines a weekend run at Helium with an opener and a feature; two-item minimum in the showroom.

title: Plastic Cup Boyz at Punch Line Philly
description: The Plastic Cup Boyz comedy troupe plays two Saturday shows and one Sunday show at Fishtown's Punch Line comedy club.

title: The Franklin Institute: Science Museum, Planetarium and Body Odyssey
description: Open daily 9:30 AM–5 PM with three floors of hands-on exhibits, live science shows, Fels Planetarium and the Giant Heart in the new Body Odyssey exhibit. Special exhibits cost extra.

title: Mütter Museum of The College of Physicians of Philadelphia
description: The renowned medical-history museum of anatomical specimens, medical instruments and curiosities is open Sunday 10 AM–5 PM. Capacity is limited to 50 guests per half hour, so pre-booking is recommended.

title: National Constitution Center: America's Founding and Pennsylvania's Founding
description: Interactive galleries on the Constitution plus the new special exhibit Pennsylvania's Founding, open September 30, 2026 through January 3, 2027. Open Wednesday through Sunday, 10 AM–5 PM.

title: Philadelphia's Magic Gardens: Mosaic Art Environment
description: Isaiah Zagar's immersive mosaic labyrinth of tile, bottles and folk art covering indoor galleries and an outdoor garden. Open Wednesday through Monday, 11 AM–6 PM.

title: Eastern State Penitentiary: Daytime Tours
description: Explore the historic prison on a self-guided audio tour (about 40 minutes) or a 45-minute guide-led tour, with art installations and mini-tours included. Open daily 10 AM–5 PM.

title: Independence Seaport Museum: USS Olympia and Submarine Becuna
description: Board the USS Olympia, the oldest steel warship afloat, and tour the WWII submarine Becuna on the Delaware waterfront. Open Thursday through Tuesday 10 AM–5 PM.

title: Elmwood Park Zoo Harvest Fest and Boo at the Zoo
time: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM (Boo at the Zoo 10:30 AM–3:30 PM)
description: Zoo-wide fall celebration with carnival games, carousel rides and live music, plus the annual Halloween Boo at the Zoo for little ghouls and ghosts. Zoo open 10 AM–5 PM.

title: Everything Everything: Get To Heaven 10th Anniversary Tour
description: UK art-rock band Everything Everything plays its Get To Heaven 10th anniversary tour, with support from Psymon Spine. Tickets through Ticketmaster; VIP upgrades offered.

title: Asha Banks: something inbetween tour
description: Singer Asha Banks brings her something inbetween tour to Brooklyn Bowl with support from Alfie Jukes. The venue listing flags tickets as almost gone.

title: Maggie Rose with Sadie Gust
description: Country and soul singer Maggie Rose headlines Ardmore Music Hall with Sadie Gust opening. Tickets are sold through Tixr.

title: The Little Mermen & The Princess Pals: Ultimate Disney Tribute Band
description: Rock & Roll Playhouse presents a Disney tribute band performing kid-friendly rock versions of favorite Disney songs at Ardmore Music Hall. Tickets through Tixr.

title: Franklin Mills Outdoor Flea Market
description: Outdoor flea market run by Phila Flea Markets at the Franklin Mills mall grounds on Sunday, October 4, 8 AM to 4 PM.
